title: Teletext
description: A Beatles teletext service on a real 40 by 25 grid, overclocked to 156 bpm: the header races through page numbers, banners cycle the eight colours, and every bar a new page drops in, from album covers redrawn in block mosaics to lyric pages where one word at a time bursts in giant double-height mosaic letters or a plasma of sextant blocks rolls behind the line. Type any page number and it holds there.
intent: Teletext stays authentic (control codes decoded like the SAA5050, eight colours, contiguous and separated mosaics, hold-mosaics, double height) but the carousel runs at a hyperpop tempo: a step sequencer flips pages, cycles colours, animates LED meters, big mosaic type and plasma, and drives an optional chiptune beat.
sources: herb reference board: fa23 Y2K montage (CRT text screens)
